फेडरेटेड आइडेंटिटी मैपिंग

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

A process that links user identities from external or partner identity providers to local systems, enabling single sign-on, unified access control, and secure collaboration.

Operational example

Integrate federated identity mapping to support SSO for business partners and enforce unified access controls across cloud and on-prem systems.
